entries.title: Emergency light at hallway in building.jpg
entries.description: Left image shows the hallway lit by existing lights, and the right shows lit by non-maintained emergency light , at the west office tower in Global Gate in Aichi, Japan. According to the Japanese Building Codes, emergency lighting must provide a level of illumination not less than 1 lx at floor level in 70 °C high temperature environment. It's power supply shall be provided not less than 30 minutes by batteries or generators.
